subject.title: [Feature]: Center the Control UI chat conversation column

question: Which existing width policy should control the shared transcript-and-composer conversation frame?
rationale: Source proves the visual mismatch and a focused implementation seam, but current main intentionally has a configurable grouped-message width and a separate fixed 48rem composer width; selecting the canonical reading measure requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Use configurable message width
options.body: Center one frame using the existing `--chat-message-max-width` contract and let the composer fill that frame, preserving custom deployment settings.

options.title: Use 48rem composer width
options.body: Constrain both transcript and composer to the current composer maximum for a consistently narrower reading measure.

options.title: Retain nested widths
options.body: Center a common outer frame while preserving a narrower composer and wider message groups within it.

recommendation.title: Use configurable message width
recommendation.body: Center one frame using the existing `--chat-message-max-width` contract and let the composer fill that frame, preserving custom deployment settings.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current-main provenance for both the composer sizing and surrounding chat composition that this decision would change.
